main_text.p: Franciscani sophistice disputandi rationem illis ad iunxerunt, addi is theologiae summis, atq; in Sententiis quaestionibus & glossis. Indeq; mox fiebant sacri Palatij magistri, haeretica pravitatis iudices, cardinales, metropolitae, ac legati apostolici. Interim Dominicus & Franciscus, pro pacti, at nunquam soluti (ut exitus probabat) caelibatus remedio, Sorores & Claritas instituerunt. Dominicus enim, teste Nicolao Triuetho, roma anno Domini 1217. domum Sororu fundauit. Doctores Canonici iuris, mathematicos, atque ingeniosos sophistas in ordinem suum admisit: quales fuerunt, Reginal-dus, Raymundus & Iordanes. Ex Francisci militi-bus, perpende Alexandrum Halesium, Guaronem, ac Scotum.

Ex Londinensi Chronico: Eo anno quo Dominicani fratres ex Italia in Angliam uenerunt, scilicet anno Domini 1224. multae pluuiae ac tonitrua fuerunt, & grandines ceciderunt instar lapidum quadrangularium, ad quorum quantitatem, quibus arbores, uineae ac segetes sunt destructae, atq; homines contriti. Aues etiam per aera uolantes, carbones ignitos in rostris deferre, ac domos incendere uidebantur. Mirabiles in Anglia (inquit Matthaeus Parisius) fuere tempestates & horrenda tonitrua, uentus furibundus

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s. The first word "Franciscani" is partly obscured at the start of the scan; the initial letter is read as F with [?] not added because the form is clear from context. "Reginal-dus" is read from a blurred word ("Regimal-"), so the reading is doubtful. The italic setting of the first passage is inferred from the slant of the type. The "Aues etiam per aera uo-" line is underlined in the scan, and the underline is not a printed feature of the text. The right-margin marks beside lines 6–7 and "Ex Londinensi" are reference symbols without printed words, so they are not transcribed as notes. The page number "535" at the top right is partly faded. The gathering signature at the foot is read as "l 4", with the last mark uncertain.
